chapters.1.meaning: Families prepare to return with gifts from their neighbors. Cyrus also returns vessels taken from the temple.
chapters.4.meaning: The letters describe opposition under several Persian kings. They do not all belong to one stage of temple building.
chapters.5.lds: Come, Follow Me asks how the people continue God’s work despite opposition.
chapters.7.summary: Ezra is a priest who studies God’s law. Artaxerxes supports his journey and gives him duties to teach and judge.
chapters.7.meaning: Ezra studies the law before living and teaching it. His journey connects these duties with the returning community.
chapters.9.lds: The Seminary lesson connects these marriages with worship of other gods. Ezra gives no personal testimony from the wives.
chapters.10.meaning: The men investigate marriages and list affected households. The chapter leaves the wives’ and children’s later lives untold.
chapters.10.lds: The Seminary lesson studies confession and repentance. What voices are missing from the account of separated families?
people.jeremiah.meaning: Ezra opens by connecting Cyrus’s proclamation with God’s message through Jeremiah.
people.nebuchadnezzar.role: Earlier Babylonian king who took people and temple vessels
people.sheshbazzar.meaning: Sheshbazzar receives the returned vessels. Chapter 5 credits him with laying the temple’s foundation.
people.mithredath-treasurer.meaning: He counts the returned vessels before handing them to Sheshbazzar.
people.zerubbabel.meaning: Zerubbabel leads the altar and temple work alongside Jeshua.
people.returning-families.meaning: The register remembers families as well as worship workers. Some families must establish their right to priestly service.
people.asaph-singer.meaning: The singers at the temple’s foundation are Asaph’s descendants.
people.darius-ezra.meaning: Darius orders a search for Cyrus’s decree. He then protects the temple work and supplies it.
people.ahasuerus-ezra.meaning: The chapter recalls an accusation made against Judah early in his reign.
people.artaxerxes-ezra.meaning: Artaxerxes authorizes Ezra to carry gifts, teach the law, and appoint judges.
people.mithredath-writer.meaning: He joins Bishlam and Tabeel in writing against Jerusalem.
people.shethar-bozenai.meaning: He joins the official inquiry and later follows Darius’s order to help the builders.
people.ezra.relations: Ezra’s family line connects him with Aaron. Artaxerxes supports his journey to Jerusalem.
people.iddo-casiphia.meaning: Ezra asks Iddo to send workers for the temple. The request brings Levites into the traveling group.
people.meremoth.meaning: Meremoth receives the silver and gold by weight when the travelers reach Jerusalem.
people.jozabad-ezra.meaning: Jozabad helps receive and weigh the treasures at Jerusalem.
people.foreign-wives-children.relations: Wives and children in households named during the marriage investigation.
people.foreign-wives-children.meaning: Shecaniah proposes sending them away. The chapter records the men’s decisions but gives none of the families’ own words.
places.jerusalem.summary: The returning community rebuilds the temple in Jerusalem. Ezra later brings gifts and teaches here.
places.sidon.summary: Workers from Sidon help supply cedar for the temple.
places.tyre.summary: Workers from Tyre help bring cedar from Lebanon to Joppa.
